title: Japanese-Style Roasted Vegetables
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegetarian dish with a variety of Japanese-inspired flavors. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms with 1 tbsp of oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and rice vinegar.
After the vegetables have been roasting for 15 minutes, brush the soy sauce and rice vinegar mixture over them.
Continue to roast for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the vegetables are caramelized and sticky.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions if desired.
